theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Rank 1 with the highest durability bar (0.68) and strong breadth (0.786), eligible under the absolute-trend gate. This is the only theme combining top momentum rank with above-average durability. However it is crowded (z 1.04, crowded true), which per guardrails is a size-down caution only — not a fade. Expressable via XEG.TO.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its own 20-day moving average at the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Rank 2, eligible, not crowded (z 0.2). Challenger to Oil & Gas with a score gap (0.502) that is not yet a confirmed handoff. Durability (0.48) is moderate but breadth is thin (0.267), suggesting leadership is concentrated in few names rather than broad. Expressable via XGD.TO.
theses.dissent: Breadth 0.267 is weak — narrow leadership is fragile and can reverse quickly; momentum rank carries no forward edge, so this is a focus observation, not a call.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO lags the S&P/TSX by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Telecom
theses.thesis: Rank 14, score -0.968, ineligible under the absolute-trend gate, with the most negative crowding_z in the set (-1.49, i.e. abandoned rather than crowded). Sustained negative trend health across durability (0.28) and breadth (0.2). Expressable via XCD.TO.
theses.dissent: Extreme negative crowding could mark capitulation rather than continued decline; the gate only controls drawdown — it does not forecast returns, and avoid is a soft preference, not a short.

falsifier.text: XCD.TO closes above its 50-day moving average at the check-by date
